#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <climits>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

long long calculate(const vector<long long>& ones, long long num, int level) {
    long long unit = ones[level];
    long long times = num / unit;
    long long leftover = num % unit;
    long long steps = times * level;
    if (leftover == 0) {
        return steps;
    }
    long long pathA = steps + calculate(ones, leftover, level - 1);
    long long pathB = steps + level + calculate(ones, unit - leftover, level - 1);
    return min(pathA, pathB);
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    
    vector<long long> ones(17, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < 17; i++) {
        ones[i] = ones[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    
    long long result = calculate(ones, n, 16);
    cout << result << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
